subject: Literature
title: Climate Fiction and the Literature of Crisis
description: A quick, practical guide to Climate Fiction and the Literature of Crisis.

hook.text: As the planet warms, a new literary genre has emerged to imagine what comes after environmental collapse.

buildup.text: Climate fiction, or cli-fi, explores rising seas, mass migration, and societal breakdown through narrative.

discovery.text: Novels like The Overstory by Richard Powers won the Pulitzer by making readers feel trees as living characters.

twist.text: Critics debate whether cli-fi inspires climate action or causes despair that makes people give up hope.

climax.text: Climate fiction may be the first literary movement born directly from a scientific consensus about the future.

punchline.text: Literature is now racing against the clock it describes.

quiz.question: What makes climate fiction unique among literary movements?
options: It is only written by scientists
It may be the first movement born from scientific consensus about the future
It only describes past environmental disasters
